name: ucss-diff
_doc: So ảnh vùng phần tử khi trang dùng CSS gốc (trái) và CSS gọn UCSS (phải). Chỉ gửi cặp đã khác pixel (lớp tất định). Claude xem mọi cặp có visible_change từ ngưỡng. Nguồn: site WordPress mẫu (OLS + LiteSpeed Cache), 26/10/2026.

visible_change.instructions: state has a short description and one image made of two screenshots of the same region of a web page, placed side by side with a solid magenta bar between them. LEFT is the page with its original stylesheet. RIGHT is the same page with a reduced stylesheet. Would a visitor notice a difference between LEFT and RIGHT: different text, a missing or extra element, a different color, font, size, border, shadow, icon or image, or a shifted layout? Ignore differences of one or two pixels, anti-aliasing, and a blinking text cursor.

change_kind.instructions: If LEFT and RIGHT differ, which difference is the most visible?
criteria: layout: an element moved, resized, wrapped differently or overlaps
unstyled: an element on the right lost its styling (plain text, no background, default list bullets, default link color)
missing: an element, icon or image is visible on one side only
color: same layout but a color, border or shadow differs
font: same layout but the font family, weight or size differs

change_box.instructions: the most visible difference between the LEFT and RIGHT halves, drawn on the RIGHT half
